description.title: הגדרות
description.summary: This table defines key terms used in the car insurance policy. It clarifies the meaning of terms like 'The policy', 'The insured', and 'Insured event' for proper interpretation of coverage.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מגדירה מונחים מרכזיים בפוליסת ביטוח רכב, כגון 'הפוליסה', 'המבוטח' ו'אירוע ביטוחי', לצורך הבנה נכונה של הכיסוי. ניתן לחפש הגדרות לפי מונח או סוג הגדרה. הפוליסה היא הפוליסה שמספרה מופיע בפירוט, שהונפקה למבוטח ביחס לשימוש ברכב. המבוטח כולל את בעלי הפוליסה וכל אדם אחר הזכאי לנהוג ברכב המעורב באירוע הביטוחי. הליכים משפטיים הם הליכים בהם הוגש כתב אישום על ידי או בשם מדינת ישראל, למעט כתבי אישום הכוללים קנס אופציונלי. אירוע ביטוחי הוא תאונת דרכים בה נפגע אדם ו/או רכוש, כתוצאה משימוש ברכב המכוסה בפוליסה. הוצאות הגנה כוללות אגרות בית משפט, מסים, אגרות חותמת, צילום פרוטוקולים, שכר מומחים שנקבעו על ידי בית המשפט, למעט קנס, פיצוי או תשלום עונשי.
notable_values: The policy: the policy whose number appears in the specification
The insured: the policy owners and/or any other person who is entitled to drive the vehicle
Legal proceedings: proceedings in which an indictment is filed by or on behalf of the State of Israel
Insured event: a road accident in which a person and/or any property is damaged
Defense expenses: court fees, levies, documents stamping fees

sketch:
Definitions
The policy -the policy whose number appears in the specification, issued to the insured in connection with use of the vehicle.
The insured -the policy owners and/or any other person who is entitled to drive the vehicle which was involved in the insured event in accordance with the policy.
Legal proceedings -proceedings in which an indictment is filed by or on behalf of the State of Israel, including administrative applications to revoke and layup a  driver's license, except for indictment which bear an optional fine.
Insured event -a road accident in which a person and/or any property is damaged, occurring as a result of use made by a vehicle, and which is covered under the policy.
Defense expenses -court fees, levies, documents stamping fees, photocopying protocols, fees of experts determined by the court or as determined in the criminal law procedure, excluding any fine, compensation, or punitive payment imposed in the framework of a verdict.

This table defines key terms used in the car insurance policy. It clarifies the meaning of terms like 'The policy', 'The insured', and 'Insured event' for proper interpretation of coverage.
ממדים: Term, Definition

Definitions
The policy -the policy whose number appears in the specification, issued to the insured in connection with use of the vehicle.
The insured -the policy owners and/or any other person who is entitled to drive the vehicle which was involved in the insured event in accordance with the policy.
Legal proceedings -proceedings in which an indictment is filed by or on behalf of the State of Israel, including administrative applications to revoke and layup a  driver's license, except for indictment which bear an optional fine.
Insured event -a road accident in which a person and/or any property is damaged, occurring as a result of use made by a vehicle, and which is covered under the policy.
Defense expenses -court fees, levies, documents stamping fees, photocopying protocols, fees of experts determined by the court or as determined in the criminal law procedure, excluding any fine, compensation, or punitive payment imposed in the framework of a verdict.
